oem_pins.description: Desired state of the placement's OEM LayoutModification.json. System placement manages the Default user template; user placement manages the current profile.

show_recent_items.description: Show recently opened items in Start, Jump Lists, and File Explorer.

show_recommendations.description: Show recommendations in the Windows 11 Start menu.

shortcuts.description: Start Menu shortcuts managed relative to the placement's Programs directory. System placement uses the all-users Start Menu; user placement uses the current user's Start Menu.

propertyNames.description: Relative .lnk path beneath the Start Menu Programs directory.

folders.description: Folders displayed beside the power button on Windows 11.
